coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: No Uzbek domestic-worker register or reporting duty found; results were about Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan (Uzbek citizens working there). Nothing usable.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No dedicated search (budget spent on breadth elsewhere); nothing new beyond K03.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Pawnshops are licensed by the Central Bank (Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 402 of 17.09.2003 plus pawnshop rules at lex.uz/acts/552772). Could not see current record-keeping duties; low-volume sector. Second-hand dealers not found in any register.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Licensed jewellery makers/IPs may buy scrap from the public and stamp their own personal hallmark; state assay chamber hallmarking; a pilot control regime ran until 1 Jan 2026; licensing digitised. See candidate on jewellers' hallmark and metal records.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No licensing or register for dismantlers found. Vehicle utilisation scheme is still at bill stage (state buy-back of cars over 30 years, e-voucher). Nothing buildable yet.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Only via the livestock/slaughter search: livestock identification system under 2023 resolution (centre at the Veterinary Committee, 25 districts first) is K05. Nothing new on livestock markets or animal transport.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Slaughter points need a veterinary-sanitary conclusion (valid 5 years, 7 working days) from the Veterinary Committee; a low-frequency duty. VIS-BILLUR beef database applies to large automated plants. Nothing new beyond K05.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: No dedicated search (budget); K04 already covers.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: No rules on vet pharmacies or vet medicine records found. Only a podrobno.uz piece saying shelters and vet clinics depend on human pharmacies because of e-prescription rules (unverified relevance).

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Water Code: special water-use permit, online meters, daily electronic journal, monthly acts, fine 40% of MRZP per 1000 m3 for unpermitted abstraction; well drilling permit from the geology committee. See water-user candidate.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Private sanitation operators hold district territories under PPP, rated monthly green/yellow/red; Law of 25.03.2026 (No. 1124) added liability for illegal removal from waste collection sites and fines for missing ecological monitoring data. No septic/biotoilet licence rules found.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Mandatory lift inspection regime from 1 July 2026 (Cabinet resolution of 12.07.2025), colour marks, authorised inspectors; conformity assessment regulation of 19.06.2026. Boilers/pressure vessels: no usable text found.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Only tariff news and water-user association (UNDP) material; no licensing or small-operator duty found. July 2026 water-sector bills passed first reading (final status unknown).

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Dealer licensing from 1 June 2025 and mandatory digital marking from May 2026 (pilot 1 May-31 Oct 2025); all this is K01. No applicator log requirement confirmed.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Private employment agencies for work abroad are licensed (5-year licence), contracts registered in the Xorijda ish system, employer register published on site; four licences cancelled in 2026. Small buyer group.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Electronic death certificates from 1 March 2026; unified electronic register of burial services planned for 1 June 2026; Tashkent pilot 1 July-31 Dec 2026 of online-only burial permits. No private funeral licence regime found.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: NGO law amendments signed 21 Aug 2025: quarterly publication of foreign-sourced assets on the Justice Ministry form; annual activity report to Justice Ministry (Cabinet Resolution of 10.03.2014, deadline 1 February, to be re-verified); NGOs reportedly file up to 18 reports. Halal supervision not checked.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Transport Ministry licenses passenger/freight carriage. Electronic waybill pilot from 1 April 2024 (Cabinet Resolution No. 44 of 22.01.2024); 155 taxi aggregators linked to tax systems and about 498,000 self-employed drivers in 2024. Status of waybills after the pilot not found.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: E-bozor platform: test launch 1 Oct 2026, full operation 1 March 2027, run by the State Tax Committee (state-built). From 1 Jan 2026 sole traders/self-employed need a UzQR/special QR code (Resolution PP-247), cash register or Paynet Xolis fiscal receipt; related to K07. Money changers: banks only, Central Bank resolution of 30.03.2026 changed rules; no non-bank changers, so not a market.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Private kindergartens, schools and training centres must run CCTV with audio from 1 July 2026 (Cabinet resolution of 21.05.2026). Driving schools licensed by the Interior Ministry since 2023 law. Tattoo, hunting and small food producers not reached.
